info.title: CivicPulse API
info.description: AI Development-Needs Intelligence Layer — Code for Communities 2.0 Track 1. Intake, Multilingual NLP, Clustering, Geospatial, Evidence, Gap Detection, and Policy Simulation. Contract: docs/api/API_CONTRACT.md

post.summary: Submit a citizen request (text or voice) — FR-001/002
post.description: Intake endpoint: runs STT, language detection, classification, NER, geocoding and clustering.
Accepts citizen audio recording, runs speech transcription and links to citizen request.

get.summary: Citizen checks own submission status (reference ID) — FR-005
get.description: Look up submission status by reference code or ID.

get.summary: List clusters, filterable by sector/district/status — FR-071 (analyst+)

get.description: Returns valid GeoJSON points for clusters. Unresolved locations have geometry: None (FR-021/033).
Returns infrastructure assets and demographic indicators alongside dataset provenance (FR-057).

post.summary: Run a policy what-if scenario — FR-053–056 (decision_maker+)
post.description: Executes deterministic scenario planning and returns coverage outcomes.

get.description: Returns baseline vs synthetic followup indicators with correlation disclaimer (FR-067).
Lists registered public datasets with versions and source labels (FR-038).
Returns an immutable audit log trail for governance and review actions (FR-062).

post.description:
Receives Telegram Bot updates, extracts text or voice messages,

processes them through the multilingual AI intake pipeline,
and returns a reply with the tracking ID.

post.summary: Twilio WhatsApp Webhook stub (text & voice) — Phase 2
post.description:
Accepts Twilio-formatted WhatsApp webhook requests (form-encoded or JSON),

runs intake through the AI pipeline, and replies with a tracking ID via TwiML XML.
